name: security-audit-parsson
description: Security audit of this repo (Eclipse Parsson / Jakarta JSON Processing impl) and its only finding
metadata:
  type: project
---

This repo is Eclipse Parsson, the reference implementation of Jakarta JSON Processing (JSON-P) — a JSON parsing/generation library, not a web app. A full first-party source audit (injection, path traversal, SSRF, XSS, deserialization, auth bypass, XXE) found only one exploitable issue, recorded in `findings.json` at the repo root.

**Why:** User requested a vulnerability review across the whole repo, excluding third-party deps.

**How to apply:** The core `impl/` library code (parser, generator, JsonPointer/JsonPatch/MergePatch) is pure in-memory JSON tree manipulation with no injection surface. The only real attack surface is in `demos/rest/.../ParserResource.java`, which streams Flickr API JSON fields unescaped into an HTML response (CWE-79). Other demos (Facebook/Twitter/servlet) are either non-web `main()` programs or don't reflect untrusted input. If asked to re-audit or extend this work, start from `findings.json` rather than re-scanning everything from scratch.

content.text: I audited the first-party code in this repo (Eclipse Parsson / Jakarta JSON Processing — a JSON library, not a web app). The core parsing/generation/pointer/patch code operates purely on in-memory JSON structures with no injection surface. The only exploitable issue is in the demo REST module: **`demos/rest/.../ParserResource.java`** (CWE-79, reflected/stored XSS): `writeFlickerFeed` streams JSON from Flickr's public "recent photos" feed and writes the `farm`, `server`, `id`, and `secret` fields directly into an HTML `` tag without escaping, then serves it as `text/html`. Since any Flickr user can contribute photos to that feed, a crafted value containing `"` or `<` breaks out of the attribute context and injects HTML/JS that runs in the browser of anyone hitting `GET /parser`. Findings written to `findings.json` at the repo root (one entry, with the source→sink path included).
